name: Project Halo
author: nyannoying
description: The 2026 F1 world feed's onboard halo for 2026, 2025 and F2 cars, an animated broadcast-style timing tower, the Race Control banner and an optional G-force meter, drawn by F1 25's own HUD. Read from the game itself: no UDP telemetry, no companion app.

options.label: Halo dial
options.description: The 2026 broadcast halo in place of the game's dial. Off: the game's own dials for every car, also in HUD customisation; the halo options below then do nothing.

options.label: Timing tower
options.description: A broadcast-style timing tower in place of the Track Position list. Off: the game's own list, lap counter and flag box, also in replays and when spectating. Changes at once.

options.label: Race Control banner
options.description: The top-centre message box in the 2026 broadcast look: navy, one line, white RACE CONTROL label. Off: the game's own message box.

options.label: Pit lane timer
options.description: The pit lane timer as a broadcast card: position, team logo, name, IN PIT and the time. Off: the game's own pit lane timer.

options.label: Lap time card
options.description: The lap time, sector bar, delta, Best and Previous as a broadcast card. Off: the game's own lap time pills.

options.label: Pit speed colour
options.description: At pit entry the whole message turns red over the limit and green under it, with PIT LIMIT beside it. Needs Race Control banner. Off: the banner's plain pit speed message.

options.label: Driver names
options.description: Your position and name, and the car one place ahead in the session's classification (the car in P2 when you lead), on the left wing. Practice, qualifying and races; not in Time Trial.

options.label: Turn numbers
options.description: The next turn's number and direction, from 220 m before it.

options.label: G-force meter
options.description: Replaces the speed, BOOST, OVERTAKE, battery and RECHARGE / DEPLOY in the middle of the halo with the 2026 broadcast's G-force meter: the cornering, braking and acceleration force in g, and a cyan arc on the side it pushes the driver.

options.label: Halo in 2025 and F2 cars
options.description: The halo in F1 25's 2025 cars and in F2 cars too, in place of their dials. 2025 cars: DRS, the ERS deploy mode, the battery and RECHARGE / DEPLOY. F2 cars: DRS, no energy parts. Off: their own dials come back. 2026 cars always show the halo.

options.label: Suggested gear
options.description: The game's gear suggestion on the halo's gear strip: the suggested gear lights up green (shift up) or amber (shift down) with a small pointer. Only while the game's suggested gear assist is on and the gear differs. Off: no mark.

options.label: Halo layout
options.description: Default camera: a symmetric halo, larger, on the car's own halo as the default T-cam shows it. TV offset: the broadcast-angle halo at the bottom, as before. A dial you moved in HUD customisation moves up with Default camera.

options.label: Validation log
options.description: Off by default. Records what the halo and the timing tower read from the game as CSV to the addon's diag folder in the game folder (two files, up to 64 MB each per launch) and shows a status line under the tower. Turn on only to send a log.

options.label: Tower layout
options.description: Around me: the rows around your position. Leaders: the top of the order. Full field: every classified car. Tower rows sets how many rows Around me and Leaders show.

options.label: Tower rows
options.description: How many rows Around me and Leaders show.

options.label: Tower header
options.description: The logo and the lap counter in races, the session name in practice and qualifying, TIME TRIAL and the lap in Time Trial, and the safety car, virtual safety car and chequered flag states.

options.label: Tyres
options.description: Each car's current tyre: S, M, H, I or W.

options.label: Position arrows
options.description: A green or red arrow for 3 seconds when a car gains or loses a place.

options.label: Intervals
options.description: The gap column: times in races (see Gap mode), and PIT, Out, DSQ and NC. In practice and qualifying, the leader's best lap and every other car's gap to it.

options.label: Gap mode
options.description: Interval: time to the car ahead. Leader: time to the leader. Auto: switches between the two. Lapped cars show +1 LAP.

options.label: Auto switch every (s)
options.description: Seconds between Interval and Leader when Gap mode is Auto.

options.label: Team logos
options.description: Shows each driver's team logo next to the name.

options.label: Highlight my row
options.description: Your own row a little brighter.

options.label: Animations
options.description: Tower: rows slide when cars change places and a new best lap fades in. Halo: the gear number ticks, the name ahead rolls over, the aero bars turn and a streak runs out on Overtake. Off: every change shows at once.
